'''Mark Balderston'''<ref name="dt-17618">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17618 KNIGHTHAMMER], DeckTech (Mark "Rogue Nine" Balderston, 18 July 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17618/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17618/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Rogue Nine''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]] list on DeckTech in July 2001.
